NASA imagery usage

These NASA GSFC Blue Marble images are used as factual source textures in an
educational graphical simulation. NASA's image/media guidance generally permits
educational and informational use of NASA content, including texture maps,
computer graphical simulations and webpages, with NASA acknowledged as source.
It distinguishes any third-party copyrighted content and prohibits implying NASA
endorsement. These images have been downloaded without alteration from the NASA
GSFC asset URLs listed in CREDITS.txt; no NASA insignia or logo is included.

This file summarizes the source guidance; it is not a separate NASA license or
an assertion that NASA endorses the project. Refer to the original guidance:
https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/

Attribution for these files is provided in CREDITS.txt.
